title: Create recent trip album
classifierDescription: User wants a new album built from a recent trip detected from photo date/location metadata.
positiveExamples: Create an album for my recent trip to USA
Make an album for my recent trip
Put my Japan trip from last week into an album
negativeExamples: Add my recent trip photos to Family
How many photos are in my recent trip album?
Pick the best photos from my recent trip

albumName.description: Explicit album name if the user gave one.

placeHint.description: Place text to bias trip detection.

matrixRow.workflowOrBoundary: `create_recent_trip_album` handles recent-trip detection, candidate choice, and album plan creation from the handle.

title: Rename or describe album
classifierDescription: User wants to rename an existing album and/or change its description, leaving its assets unchanged.
positiveExamples: Rename this album to Berlin Weekend
Rename the Family album to Family 2026 and add a description
Change the description on my Italy album
negativeExamples: Add my newest photos to the Family album
Delete the Family album
Create an album for my recent trip

albumRef.description: How the user referred to the album.

matrixRow.workflowOrBoundary: Direct album-detail update plan; preserve unspecified fields.

title: Add photos to existing album
classifierDescription: User wants to add a metadata-describable set of photos to an existing album.
positiveExamples: Add my newest 20 photos to Family
Add my Berlin photos from last weekend to the Trips album
negativeExamples: Add the good ones to Family
Create a new album from my Berlin photos

sourceDescription.description: Metadata description of the photos to add.

matrixRow.workflowOrBoundary: Pi resolves the source; Gallery owns album lookup, duplicate-safe add, and plan creation.

title: Archive or unarchive photos
classifierDescription: User wants to archive or unarchive a metadata-describable set of photos (recency/date/type bound) or a named entity (people, place, tag, camera, rating, favorites).
positiveExamples: Archive my newest 50 photos
Unarchive my last 10 photos
Move my 2024 videos out of the archive
Archive my Berlin photos
negativeExamples: Archive the best photos from last weekend
Archive the Family album
Add my newest 20 photos to Family

archived.description: true to archive, false to unarchive (default archive).

sourceDescription.description: Metadata description of the photos to (un)archive.

matrixRow.workflowOrBoundary: Pi resolves a recency/date/type source; Gallery owns the batch archive plan from the handle.

title: Favorite or unfavorite photos
classifierDescription: User wants to favorite or unfavorite a metadata-describable set of photos or a named entity (people, place, tag, camera, rating, favorites).
positiveExamples: Favorite my newest 10 photos
Unfavorite my last 5 photos
Like my newest 20 photos
Favorite my 5-star photos
negativeExamples: Favorite the best 3 photos from last weekend
Favorite the Family album
Add the good ones to Family

favorite.description: true to favorite, false to unfavorite (default favorite).

sourceDescription.description: Metadata description of the photos to (un)favorite.

matrixRow.workflowOrBoundary: Pi resolves a recency/date/type source; Gallery owns the batch favorite plan from the handle.

title: Tag photos (add)
classifierDescription: User wants to add a tag to a metadata-describable set of photos (add-only; no tag removal) or a named entity (people, place, tag, camera, rating, favorites).
positiveExamples: Tag my newest 20 photos as Travel
Add the tag Spring Break to my newest 50 photos
Add the Travel tag to my last 10 photos
Tag photos of Alex as Family
negativeExamples: Remove the Travel tag from my newest 20
Tag the best ones as Travel
Add my newest 20 photos to the Travel album

sourceDescription.description: Metadata description of the photos to tag.

matrixRow.workflowOrBoundary: Add-only; Pi resolves the source; Gallery owns the batch tag-add plan from the handle.

title: Edit photo metadata
classifierDescription: User wants to edit metadata (description/caption, star rating, capture date, time zone, or explicit lat+lng location) on a metadata-describable set of LOOSE photos — not an album or a space.
positiveExamples: Set the description on my newest 20 photos to Berlin weekend
Rate my newest 12 photos five stars
Set the timezone on my newest 20 photos to Europe/Berlin
negativeExamples: Set the description on the Family album to Summer 2026
Set the description on the Trips space to Our adventures
Set the location on these photos to Paris

field.description: description, rating, timeZone, location, or date.

value.description: New value (text, 1-5 or clear for rating, IANA zone, ISO date).

latitude.description: Latitude for a location edit (with longitude).

longitude.description: Longitude for a location edit (with latitude).

sourceDescription.description: Metadata description of the photos to edit.

matrixRow.workflowOrBoundary: Pi resolves a loose-asset source and the field/value; Gallery owns the batch metadata-update plan from the handle.

title: Rename or describe space
classifierDescription: User wants to rename a shared space and/or change its description, leaving members and assets unchanged.
positiveExamples: Rename the Family space to Family 2026
Set the description on the Trips space to Our adventures
Change the description on my Family space
negativeExamples: Rename the Family album to Family 2026
Add Alex to the Family space
Make Alex an editor in Family

spaceRef.description: How the user referred to the space.

matrixRow.workflowOrBoundary: Direct space-detail update plan; preserve unspecified fields.

title: Add or remove space members
classifierDescription: User wants to add or remove members of a shared space, optionally with a role.
positiveExamples: Add Alex to the Family space as editor
Add Sam and Jo to the Trips space
Remove Bob from the Family space
negativeExamples: Add my newest 20 photos to the Family space
Make Alex an editor in Family
Rename the Family space to Family 2026

memberQueries.description: Member names or emails to add or remove.

spaceRef.description: How the user referred to the space.

role.description: editor or viewer (default viewer on add).

matrixRow.workflowOrBoundary: Resolve members; guard owner/self/last-owner removal; propose the membership plan.

title: Change a space member's role

Change Bob's role to viewer in Trips
Make Sam a viewer in Family
negativeExamples: Add Alex to the Family space
Remove Bob from the Family space
Rename the Family space to Family 2026

spaceRef.description: How the user referred to the space.

matrixRow.workflowOrBoundary: Resolve the member; guard owner/self/no-op; propose the role-change plan.

title: Create album from a source
classifierDescription: User wants a NEW album built from a metadata-describable set of photos (recency, date, type, or a named entity like people/tag/camera/rating/favorites), not a recent trip, vacation, or getaway.
positiveExamples: Make an album of my newest 50 photos
Create an album from my 2024 photos called Best of 2024
Build an album of my newest 100 photos
Make an album of my Sony photos
negativeExamples: Create an album for my recent trip to USA
Add my newest 20 photos to Family
Make an album of the best photos

sourceDescription.description: Metadata description of the photos for the new album.

matrixRow.workflowOrBoundary: Pi resolves a recency/date/type source; Gallery owns album creation from the handle.
